businessStage.title: Business stage
businessStage.body: Where a product sits in the Code 92 funnel: Idea → Concept → Build → Venture → Company → Board. Moving forward past Concept and Venture needs a gate decision.

gate.title: Gate
gate.body: A go / no-go decision by the founders. Gate 1 (after Concept) confirms an operator and a go; Gate 2 (after Venture) confirms product-market fit. A product cannot move past a gate without a “go”.

release.title: Release
release.body: One version of a product being shipped. It moves through stages, and each stage closes only when its evidence is attached.

releaseStage.title: Release stage
releaseStage.body: The step a release is on: Plan → Design → Build → Test → Deploy → Maintain. Each stage lists the documents (evidence) needed to close it.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.body: The documents that prove a release stage was done properly, such as a spec, a test report or a deploy record. Governance shows which ones are still missing.

projectPhase.title: Project phase
projectPhase.body: Where a consultation engagement stands: Kickoff → Discovery → Delivery → Handover → Closed. A project with no activity for a while is marked stale.

taskStatus.title: Task status
taskStatus.body: Every task is To do, In progress, Blocked or Done. It is the same status on every screen: change it anywhere and it changes everywhere.

waitingOnMe.title: Waiting on me
waitingOnMe.body: Things that need your decision or reply: gate decisions, spec approvals, agent proposals, unanswered mentions and deals that need a next step.

follow.title: Following
follow.body: Follow a task to get a notification when it changes or is completed. You follow tasks you create or are assigned automatically.
